verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an npm library that you instantiate inside your own app (`betterAuth({...})`), and it stores user data in a database you configure, such as SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. Independent users confirm they keep all auth data in their own database, own the data, are not tied to any database provider, and use the open-source package in production. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of deployment topologies (e.g., private/air-gapped or region-restricted hosting guidance).
